title: Role of Artificial Intelligence in Breast Cancer Screening Via Mammography
official: Role of Artificial Intelligence in Breast Cancer Screening Via Mammography
summary: to evaluate the diagnostic performance of radiologists using the Transpara™ Incepto® software to interpret 2D mammograms with tomosynthesis as part of breast cancer screening
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* A woman referred for a bilateral mammogram as part of individual or organised screening,
* Patient aged 18 or over,
* A patient who has read the information leaflet and signed the informed consent form,
* A patient with health insurance cover.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a history of breast cancer,
* Patients with a history of breast surgery (cosmetic and/or therapeutic),
* Patients with a history of radiotherapy to the breast,
* Vulnerable populations and participants as defined in Articles 64 to 68 of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5 April 2017.
